text.zh:
五年后，塞卢纳空荡的街区里，有一面墙是一个猿人唱好的。裂缝合得歪歪扭扭，可它不再漏光了。
艾拉瑞斯说，你永远成不了灵骨歌者。
他说这话时，正在教你下一首歌。
text.en:
Five years on, in one of Selunar's empty districts, there is a wall a mon-keigh sang whole. The crack healed crooked, but it no longer leaks light.
Ellaris says you will never be a Bonesinger.
He says it while teaching you the next song.

text.zh:
三年后，伊尔达涅斯河边多了一块麦田，是一个猿人种的。
你教流亡者的孩子唱收割歌。他们唱得比你还难听。
有时先知会来，站在田埂上，什么也不说，只看着麦子。
text.en:
Three years on, a wheat field grows by Ildaneth's river, planted by a mon-keigh.
You teach the Exodite children the harvest song. They sing it even worse than you.
Sometimes the Farseer visits, stands at the field's edge, says nothing, and watches the wheat.

text.zh:
丑角剧团多了一个观众。他们从不让你上台，只让你在黑暗里笑第一声。
每次《陨落》演到结尾，台下最先笑出来的，总是那个猿人。
有人说，欢笑之神本人来看过一场，笑得最响的就是他。
text.en:
The Harlequin troupe gains an audience of one. They never let you on stage; they only let you laugh first in the dark.
Every time The Fall reaches its end, the first laugh from the seats is always the mon-keigh's.
They say the Laughing God himself attended once, and laughed the loudest.

text.zh:
你跟着恩灵派走遍了网道。他们叫你“活着的那个”：队伍里只有你活不过一千岁。
伊芙蕾恩远远地看过你一眼，点了点头。
你教过一个死去的朋友吹口哨。现在，你常常替她吹。
text.en:
You walk the webway with the Ynnari. They call you “the living one”: you're the only one among them who won't see a thousand years.
Yvraine glances at you once from afar, and nods.
You once taught a friend, now dead, to whistle. These days you often whistle for her.

text.zh:
你回到人类那边，讲了一切：灵族、网道、先知、那两个数字。
审判官记着笔记。“与异形同处逾年，”她合上本子，“灵魂已不可信。”
第二天广场上点起火堆，人们唱着赞美帝皇的歌。
text.en:
Back among humans, you tell them everything: the Aeldari, the webway, the Farseer, the two numbers.
The Inquisitor takes notes. “Over a year among xenos,” she says, closing her book. “The soul cannot be trusted.”
Next day a pyre is lit in the square, and the crowd sings praise to the Emperor.

text.zh:
心里那团火一旦点着，就再也没熄过。灵族有道途约束杀意，你没有。
守护者把你送出了网道。你一路杀进黑暗，没回过头。
凯恩的怒火属于灵族。你的，被另一位神接住了。他不讲道途，只要头骨。
text.en:
Once the fire in you caught, it never went out. The Aeldari have their Paths to cage the urge to kill. You have none.
The Guardians see you out of the webway. You fight your way into the dark and never look back.
Khaine's rage belongs to the Aeldari. Yours was caught by another god. He keeps no Paths. He wants skulls.

text.zh:
你的伤口不再愈合，却开出了花。灵骨歌者的歌，在你身边一首首走了调。
灵族把你送到一颗无人的星球，留下一袋种子，走得远远的。
你在那里种出一座园子。苍蝇来了，园丁也来了。他说你种得真好。
text.en:
Your wounds no longer heal; they bloom. Near you, the bonesingers' songs go out of tune one by one.
The Aeldari leave you on an empty world with a bag of seeds, and keep far away.
There you grow a garden. The flies come, and then the Gardener. He says you've done beautifully.

text.zh:
那段甜甜的音乐再也不停了。你坐下来听，听了一天，一个月，一年。
后来有人发现你，你还坐着微笑，灵魂早已不在，没有灵魂石接住它。
渴求者饿了一万年。一个猿人的灵魂，只是饭前的甜点。
text.en:
The sweet music never stops now. You sit and listen: a day, a month, a year.
When someone finally finds you, you are still sitting and smiling, your soul long gone. No spirit stone caught it.
She Who Thirsts has hungered for ten thousand years. A mon-keigh soul is a sweet before the meal.

text.zh:
你看见的命运线越来越多，比先知还多。你开始悄悄拨动其中几根。
先知发现时，已有三条线因你而断。她第一次在你面前失了态。
你笑了。拨线的从来不是你，是一个比所有先知都更爱计划的东西。
text.en:
You see more fate-threads every day, more than the seers. You begin quietly plucking a few.
By the time the Farseer notices, three threads have snapped because of you. For the first time she loses her composure before you.
You laugh. It was never you plucking them. It was something that loves plans more than any seer.

cause.zh: 被黑暗灵族掳往科摩拉

text.zh:
科摩拉没有太阳。你学会了很多事：怎么笑得让主人满意，怎么在拍卖台上站得笔直。
你的新主人说，猿人最有趣的地方，是会一直抱着希望。
她说得对。你到现在还在希望。
text.en:
Commorragh has no sun. You learn many things: how to smile so your owner is pleased, how to stand straight on the auction block.
Your new owner says the most amusing thing about mon-keigh is that they keep hoping.
She's right. You're hoping still.

text.zh:
第二天，一个银色的骷髅停在你面前，抬起了手。你没有跑。
很久以后，瓦尔达又长满了麦子，没人收割。
先知说过，墓穴会重新睡着。她说对了——它睡得很满足。
text.en:
Next day a silver skeleton stops before you and raises a hand. You don't run.
Long after, Valda is thick with wheat again, and no one harvests it.
The Farseer said the tomb would sleep again. She was right. It sleeps content.

text.zh:
你等了很久，久到忘了自己在等什么。
偶尔有一队舞者从远处经过，在你面前停一停，做个鬼脸，又走了。
网道很大。在它的某个角落，有一个不会变老的猿人，还在数脚步。
text.en:
You wait a long time, long enough to forget what you were waiting for.
Now and then a troupe of dancers passes, pauses before you, pulls a face, and moves on.
The webway is vast. Somewhere in it, a mon-keigh who never grows old is still counting footsteps.

text.zh:
门合上了。另一边，先知垂下眼睛，在符文上划掉一根线。
你和大魔一起被封在网道里。它不急，它有的是时间；你会慢慢变得不那么干净。
text.en:
The gate closes. On the other side the Farseer lowers her eyes and strikes a thread from her runes.
You are sealed in the webway with the daemon. It's in no hurry; it has all the time there is, and you will grow less clean.

text.zh:
你点了头。瓦尔达的麦田在你周围展开，完美无缺，妮尔在门口等你。
你进门，坐下，吃饭。每一顿都一样完美。
每一天都一样。你想停下，却想不起该怎么停。很远的地方，有什么正吃得很开心。
text.en:
You nod. Valda's fields unfold around you, flawless; Nell waits at the door.
You go in, sit down, eat. Every supper is just as perfect.
Every single day. You want to stop, but can't remember how. Far away, something is feasting happily.

text.zh:
你想要的越来越多，多到身体装不下。皮肤发光，长出不该有的颜色，声音甜得像音乐。
看见你的人都举起了枪，眼里没有恨，只有怜悯。
在他们开枪之前，很远的地方，有什么东西先一步把你喝干了。
text.en:
You want more and more, more than a body can hold. Your skin begins to glow in colours it should not have; your voice turns sweet as music.
Everyone who sees you raises a gun, with no hatred in their eyes, only pity.
Before they fire, something very far away drinks you dry.

text.zh:
你倒下了。灵族们停下脚步，低头看了你一会儿，很有礼貌。
没有灵魂石接住你。你的灵魂升起来，又亮又干净，像一盏灯，被远处某个很饿的东西看见了。
先知在符文上，轻轻划掉了一根线。
text.en:
You fall. The Aeldari pause and look down at you a moment, politely.
No spirit stone catches you. Your soul rises, bright and clean as a lamp, and something very hungry far away notices it.
On her runes, the Farseer gently strikes out a thread.

text.zh:
你开始听见墙里所有的声音，一万个死去的灵族同时说话，你一个也挡不住。
你给每个声音起了名字，日夜和他们聊天。
灵族把你送进一间安静的房间，天花板很矮，按猿人规格。
text.en:
You begin to hear every voice in the walls, ten thousand dead Aeldari speaking at once, and you can shut out none of them.
You name each voice and talk with them day and night.
The Aeldari place you in a quiet room with a low ceiling, built to mon-keigh specifications.

text.zh:
你拖着斧子爬上最后一艘起飞的登陆艇。身后，阿尔德林在灭绝令中变成一颗白色的星。
星系边缘的旗舰上，战帅阿巴顿看了你一眼——就一眼——然后继续看他的星图。
够了。对你这样的人来说，够了。
text.en:
You drag the axe aboard the last lander to lift off. Behind you, Aldrin becomes a white star under Exterminatus.
On the flagship at the system's edge, Warmaster Abaddon glances at you—just once—then returns to his star charts.
It's enough. For someone like you, it's enough.

text.zh:
血神承认了你。你的盔甲换成黄铜，名字刻进斧刃，每一场仗都比上一场更大。
你在一千个世界上冲锋，从不回头，也从不休息。
恐虐从不赏赐安宁，只赏赐下一个对手。对你来说，这就够了。
text.en:
The Blood God acknowledges you. Your armour turns to brass, your name is etched into the axe-blade, every war bigger than the last.
You charge across a thousand worlds, never looking back, never resting.
Khorne grants no peace, only the next foe. For you, that is enough.

text.zh:
老爷爷亲手给你系上了围裙。你成了花园的园丁，替他照看一种又一种新生的瘟疫。
你身上烂了七处，处处都开着花。小东西们说你笑起来最好看。
你从没这么快乐过，也永远不会再孤单。
text.en:
Grandfather ties an apron on you himself. You become a gardener, tending one newborn plague after another for him.
You are rotten in seven places, and every one of them is in bloom. The little ones say your smile is the loveliest.
You have never been so happy, and you will never be alone again.

text.zh:
你成了宴会的主人。宾客为你而来，为你着迷，为你倾尽所有。
你是完美的，每一面镜子都这么说。
可你只想要下一个更完美的瞬间，永远想要。在她的国度里，这就叫恩宠。
text.en:
You become the host of the feast. Guests come for you, are enthralled by you, give you everything they have.
You are perfect; every mirror says so.
Yet all you want is the next, more perfect moment, forever. In Her realm, that is called favour.

text.zh:
你成了改变之主的书记，替他写下一千个未来，再一个个划掉。
你的身体每天都不一样：今天长羽毛，明天长眼睛。你喜欢这种不确定。
你也知道，总有一天他会把你写死。那也在计划之中。
text.en:
You become the Changer's scribe, writing a thousand futures for him and crossing them out one by one.
Your body is different every day: feathers today, eyes tomorrow. You like not knowing.
You know he'll write you out one day. That, too, is part of the plan.

text.zh:
恐惧之眼里多了一位新的恶魔王子。凡人的岁月从你身上滑过，像雨滑过铁甲。
很多年后，某个巢都的垃圾瀑布下，一个缺门牙的孩子捡到一尊温热的小雕像。
雕像的脸，是你的。
text.en:
The Eye of Terror has a new Daemon Prince. Mortal years slide off you like rain off armour.
Many years later, beneath the garbage falls of some hive, a gap-toothed child finds a warm little statue.
Its face is yours.

text.zh:
撤离船把你卸在另一颗巢都星球。两年后，你在下巢的净水站排班。
手腕上的烙印偶尔还会发烫。每当那时，你就哼起诗班的歌，再故意唱错一个音。
诸神找不到唱错的人。至少你希望如此。
text.en:
The evacuation ship drops you on another hive world. Two years later you work shifts at an underhive water station.
The brand on your wrist still warms now and then. When it does, you hum the Choir's hymn and sing one note wrong on purpose.
The gods can't find someone singing off-key. Or so you hope.

text.zh:
你成了血神的猎犬：没有名字，没有诗班，只有下一场仗。
多年后，你走过的每个地方都有人用你的故事吓唬孩子：一个凡人从烂泥里爬出来，从此再没停下。
头骨一颗颗堆向王座，永远堆不满。
text.en:
You become a hound of the Blood God: no name, no Choir, only the next battle.
Years later, everywhere you passed, people frighten children with your story: a mortal who crawled out of the mud and never stopped.
Skull after skull piles toward the throne. It is never enough.

title.en: The Warm Stove in the Sump

text.zh:
你在最近的一摊烂泥里躺下，再也不想起来。苍蝇在你身上安了家，菌菇从指缝里长出来。
路过的人都爱在你身边歇脚，说你身上暖洋洋的，像个炉子。
慈父的花园里没有谁是多余的，也没有谁能离开。
text.en:
You lie down in the nearest patch of mud and never want to get up. Flies make a home of you; mushrooms sprout between your fingers.
Passers-by like to rest beside you. You're warm, they say, like a stove.
In Grandfather's garden no one is unwanted, and no one ever leaves.

text.zh:
你追逐每一种滋味：更甜的酒，更高的音，更多的目光。
每尝一次，世界就淡一点。最后你坐在一场永不散场的宴席上，盘子总是满的，你却什么都尝不到。
她给你一切，直到你什么都不是。
text.en:
You chase every taste: sweeter wine, higher notes, more eyes upon you.
Each taste leaves the world a little paler. At last you sit at a banquet that never ends, plate always full, tasting nothing.
She gives you everything, until you are nothing.

text.zh:
你开始照着脑子里的剧本过日子。每一步都很顺，顺得可疑。
剧本最后一页写着：你死于一场你亲手策划的背叛。读到这一行时，已经来不及改了。
万变之主的计划里，你只是一行注脚。
text.en:
You start living by a script in your head. Every step goes smoothly. Suspiciously smoothly.
The last page reads: you die in a betrayal you plotted yourself. By the time you read that line, it's too late to change it.
In the Changer of Ways' plan, you were a footnote.

text.zh:
就一道。再一道。再一首。
外面过去了一千年，宴会还在继续。你的盘子永远是满的，你的笑容永远是完美的。
你再也想不起门在哪里。你也不想想起。
text.en:
Just one more dish. One more. One more song.
Outside, a thousand years go by, and the feast goes on. Your plate is always full, your smile always perfect.
You can no longer remember where the door was. You don't want to.

text.zh:
你祈祷了。笨拙地，不知道该说什么。
光回应了你。不是宽恕，是火。
斯特兰德后来在报告里写：“该异端死前在祈祷。备注：无关紧要。”
text.en:
You pray. Clumsily, not knowing what to say.
The light answers. Not with forgiveness. With fire.
Strand later writes in her report: “Heretic was praying at time of death. Note: irrelevant.”

text.zh:
光落下时没有声音——士兵的小灯，或者骑士的戟，都一样。
审判庭的档案里，你只有一行字：“阿尔德林，异端，已净化。”没有名字。
六小时后，这行字所指的那颗星球，也不存在了。
text.en:
When the light falls there is no sound: a trooper's little lamp or a knight's halberd, it's all the same.
In the Inquisition's records you are one line: “Aldrin. Heretic. Purged.” No name.
Six hours later, the world that line refers to no longer exists either.

text.zh:
斯特兰德摘下一只手套，又仔细地戴回去。
第二天，广场上立起了一根木桩。人们被要求观看。
审判官全程没有看火，她在看人群里谁移开了眼睛。
text.en:
Strand removes one glove, then carefully puts it back on.
The next day a stake rises in the square. Attendance is mandatory.
The Inquisitor never watches the fire. She watches the crowd, noting who looks away.

text.zh:
门很结实。
后来，诗班的人提起你都很尊敬：第一个被献给四位的人，祭坛的烛火为你烧了一整夜。
蒂卡每天都给你的空座位盛一碗汤。
text.en:
The doors hold.
Afterward the Choir speaks of you with reverence: the first one given to the Four. The altar candles burned all night for you.
Every day, Tikka sets a bowl of soup at your empty place.

text.zh:
诸神一次给了你太多恩赐：触手、眼睛、翅膀、嘴巴，一样不少。
你的身体装不下。
后来，有人见过一只会追着自己尾巴咬的怪物。偶尔它会停下来，像在努力回想一个名字。
text.en:
The gods gave you too many gifts at once: tentacles, eyes, wings, mouths, everything.
Your body couldn't hold them.
Later, people saw a beast that chases its own tails. Sometimes it stops, as if trying to recall a name.

text.zh:
下巢的规矩，到哪儿都一样：人死了，东西归活人。
有人拿走了你的鞋，有人拿走了你手里的家伙。没人记得你的名字。
四位神没有一个回头看。
text.en:
The underhive's rule holds everywhere: when someone dies, their things go to the living.
Someone takes your shoes. Someone takes whatever you were holding. Nobody remembers your name.
Not one of the Four looks back.

text.zh:
你脑子里那些声音不再争吵了，因为它们都进来了。
你同时在笑、在哭、在愤怒、在渴望。你的嘴说着四种语言，没有一种是你的。
诸神很满意。只是没有“你”了。
text.en:
The voices in your head stop arguing, because now they're all inside.
You laugh, weep, rage and crave all at once. Your mouth speaks four languages, none of them yours.
The gods are pleased. There's just no “you” left.

text.zh:
“忍耐号”飞向奥雷克斯二号，载着一船孩子，个个都是素脸。
身后，凯辛三号变成了一颗紫色的星，然后什么也不剩。
你教孩子们唱歌。不是那首。是一首新的。
text.en:
The Endurance flies for Aurex Secundus with a hold full of children, plain-faced every one.
Behind you Kessin Tertius becomes a violet star, then nothing at all.
You teach the children a song. Not that one. A new one.

cause.en: Held the line so the children could go

text.zh:
你和留下的人守着空荡荡的星港，一直守到天黑。
矿船的尾焰变成一颗小星星，又变成什么都没有。
你点点头。这辈子，这是你干过最值的一班。
text.en:
You and those who stayed hold the empty starport until nightfall.
The hauler's exhaust becomes a small star, then nothing.
You nod. It's the best shift you ever worked.

cause.en: Killed the Patriarch, sent the warning

text.zh:
影子还在，可歌停了，影子掀开了一道缝，正好够一句话。九天后，帝国海军的炮火照亮了紫天。
凯辛三号没保住，可整个阿尔科萨星区都听见了它的名字。
你坐在塔的废墟上，和你记得的每一张脸。
text.en:
The Shadow remains, but the song stopped, and for the space of one sentence it lifted. Nine days later Imperial Navy guns light the violet sky.
Kessin Tertius could not be saved, but the whole Arcosa Sector heard its name.
You sit in the tower's ruins with every face you remember.

text.zh:
审判官的船上，你讲了一年。四代人的名字，每一碗汤，每一首歌。
异形审判庭的档案里多了一卷：“凯辛三号：一个家庭的完整记录”。
审判官说，下一颗星球，会因为这一卷早一点被发现。
text.en:
Aboard the Inquisitor's ship you talk for a year. Four generations of names, every bowl of soup, every song.
The Ordo Xenos archive gains a volume: “Kessin Tertius: the complete record of one family.”
The Inquisitor says the next world will be found a little sooner because of it.

text.zh:
升天之日，你和家人们站在一起，仰着头。
星之子降下来了，正如主祭说的那样，把你们全都接走，变成他们的一部分。
一点也不剩。他们甚至不知道，你们曾经为他们唱过歌。
text.en:
On the Day of Ascension you stand with the family, faces upturned.
The Star Children descend, just as the Magus said, and take you all up, make you part of them.
Nothing is left over. They never even knew you once sang for them.

text.zh:
你一直待在矿井最深处。灯灭了，刮擦声停了，地面上的声音也停了。
后来，什么声音都没有了。
你在黑暗里待了很久。这颗星上，你是最后一个记得那些歌的人。
text.en:
You stay at the very bottom of the mine. The lamp dies; the scraping stops; the sounds above stop too.
Then there is no sound at all.
You stay in the dark a long time. On this world, you are the last one who remembers the songs.

cause.zh: 影子退去时被恐虐收走
cause.en: Taken by Khorne as the Shadow lifted

text.zh:
从那天起，你开始打架：在矿口，在集市，在家里。后来天变紫了，你在废墟里杀了十天虫子。
影子罩着这颗星，诸神听不见。可你的怒火漏了出去。
影子退去那夜，一面鼓找到了你。它不在乎血是谁的。
text.en:
From that day you fight: at the pithead, in the market, at home. Then the sky turns violet, and you kill beasts in the ruins for ten days.
The Shadow covers this world and the gods can't hear. But your rage is too big, and leaks out beneath it.
The night the Shadow lifts, a drum finds you. It doesn't care whose blood it was.

cause.en: Kept by Nurgle for his garden

text.zh:
从那天起，你身上长出了别的东西，又暖又软，不是家族的，是另一种爱。
后来虫群来了，把所有活物都收走。只有你，它们嗅了嗅，绕开了。
连吞噬者都不要你。可慈祥的祖父要。他一向什么都要。
text.en:
From that day something else grows in you, warm and soft. Not the family's. A different kind of love.
Later the swarm comes and gathers every living thing. You alone they sniff, and pass by.
Even the Devourer doesn't want you. But a kindly Grandfather does. He always wants everything.

text.zh:
家族的爱太满了，你离不开。从那天起你一直在唱，家人都不在了，你还在空礼拜堂里唱给自己听。
影子里她听不见你。你的渴望一遍遍回响，越来越甜。
影子退去那天，她就在门口，等着听第一万遍。
text.en:
The family's love was so full you can't do without it. From that day you sing, and when the kin are gone you still sing in the empty chapel, to yourself.
In the Shadow she can't hear you, so your longing only echoes, sweeter each time.
The day the Shadow lifts, she's waiting at the door to hear it for the ten-thousandth time.

name.en: An Echo in the Empty Chapel

cause.zh: 从影子的缝隙被奸奇带走
cause.en: Slipped through the Shadow to Tzeentch

text.zh:
影子那么大，大得像一面墙。可墙上有一道缝，正好是你的形状。
有人很早就在等你了，比老祖宗来得更早，比星之子来得更早。
“家族是个好计划，”那个声音说，“可我的计划，更长。”
text.en:
The Shadow is vast as a wall. But the wall has a crack in it, exactly your shape.
Someone has been waiting for you a long time: since before the Grandsire, before the Star Children.
“The family was a good plan,” the voice says. “Mine is longer.”

cause.en: Mind smoothed away by the Magus

text.zh:
主祭治好了你。你再也不害怕了，再也不怀疑了。
你每天都笑，笑得和所有人一模一样，嗡鸣替你记着一切。
升天之日来的时候，你是第一个跑去迎接的。
text.en:
The Magus heals you. You are never afraid again, never doubtful again.
You smile every day, exactly like everyone else; the hum remembers everything for you.
When the Day of Ascension comes, you are the first to run out and greet it.

text.zh:
你没有跑掉。
后来，整颗星球的一切活物都被收走：矿工、执法官、家人、孢子底下的苔藓。
虫群离开时，凯辛三号只剩下光秃秃的石头，和一座还挂着四臂像的空房子。
text.en:
You don't get away.
Afterward everything living on the world is gathered up: miners, enforcers, kin, the moss beneath the spores.
When the swarm leaves, Kessin Tertius is bare stone, and one empty house with a four-armed icon on the wall.

cause.zh: 占了孩子的座位活下来
cause.en: Lived by taking a child's seat

text.zh:
“忍耐号”飞向奥雷克斯二号。你坐在靠窗的位置，舷窗外，凯辛三号变成一颗紫色的星。
舱门的缝里，还卡着一只小孩的鞋。
你一路都没有回头。你活下来了。只是活下来了。
text.en:
The Endurance flies for Aurex Secundus. You have the window seat; outside, Kessin Tertius becomes a violet star.
Wedged in the hatch seam is one small child's shoe.
You never look back, the whole way. You lived. That's all you did.

text.zh:
审判庭的名单很长，你在第四百一十二行。
罪名是“与异形勾结”。你想说，他们只是给了你一碗汤。
审判官合上名单，第四百一十三行，是内尔。
text.en:
The Inquisition's list is long. You're on line four hundred and twelve.
Charge: consorting with the xenos. You want to say they only gave you a bowl of soup.
The Inquisitor closes the list. Line four hundred and thirteen is Nell.

cause.zh: 把家族带到了新的星球
cause.en: Carried the family to a new world

text.zh:
“忍耐号”到了奥雷克斯二号。你在下巢找了份活，过得很安静。
五年后，下巢有一户新的人家，星期天总多做一份饭，墙上挂着一幅四只手的帝皇像。
孩子们都长着同一双淡紫色的眼睛。
text.en:
The Endurance reaches Aurex Secundus. You find work in the underhive and live quietly.
Five years later a new underhive family always cooks one extra plate on Sundays, and a four-armed Emperor hangs on their wall.
The children all share the same pale violet eyes.

cause.en: Wholly consumed by the family's blood

text.zh:
家的血终于把你填满了。你的皮肤越来越硬，你的心越来越暖，你想不起“我”这个字。
你听见一个很老、很老的声音，很满意。
你是家的一部分了。只是一部分。
text.en:
The family's blood fills you at last. Your skin hardens, your heart warms, and you can't recall the word “I.”
You hear a very, very old voice, satisfied.
You are part of the family now. Only a part.

text.zh:
你倒下的地方，灯滚出去很远，照着一面墙上的小画：四只手的人，落下的星星。
过了一会儿，几个戴兜帽的人来了，把你抬走，像抬家人一样小心。
他们照顾自己人。到最后也是。
text.en:
Where you fall, your lamp rolls far off and lights some little carvings on a wall: four-armed figures, falling stars.
After a while hooded figures come and carry you away, careful as with family.
They look after their own. To the very end.

text.zh:
你再也分不清哪个声音是自己的了。
嗡鸣里有几百个声音，你挑了一个最温柔的，跟着它走，再也没回来。
家里多了一个总在微笑的人。没人记得这人原来叫什么。
text.en:
You can no longer tell which voice is yours.
The hum holds hundreds. You pick the gentlest, follow it, and never come back.
The family gains one more person who always smiles. Nobody remembers their old name.

text.zh:
你登上了战斗群的蓝金色战舰。新军服，新番号，新的一万光年。
启航时，你最后看了一眼故乡的天空。那道裂隙还在，像一道永远合不上的伤口。
但至少，现在有人在缝它了。
text.en:
You board one of the battle group's blue-and-gold warships. New uniform, new regiment, ten thousand new light-years.
As the fleet departs you take a last look at home's sky. The rift is still there, a wound that will never close.
But at least someone is stitching it now.

text.zh:
一年后，你站在重建的楼梯间里，卖掺三成水的再生咖啡。今天免费。
哈洛念阵亡名单，念到佩尔时放慢了，像在道谢。
帝皇从没看过你一眼。但你看见了他的人民。
text.en:
A year later you stand in the rebuilt stairwell selling recaff, a third of it water. Free today.
Hallow reads the names of the dead. At Pell's he slows down, like a thank-you.
The Emperor never looked your way. But you saw his people.

text.zh:
穿梭机里，哈克审判官在剥一个橘子。“你还留着它，”她瞥了眼硬币，“很好。”
“从今天起你不存在了。你会去很多地方，看很多不该看的东西，然后决定谁活。”
她递给你半个橘子。
text.en:
In the shuttle, Inquisitor Haak is peeling an orange. “You kept it,” she says, eyeing the coin. “Good.”
“From today, you don't exist. You'll go many places, see many things you shouldn't, and decide who lives.”
She hands you half the orange.

text.zh:
你没有回营地。四十个小时里，他们给你换上干净衣服，叫你“家人”。你从没这么安心过。
天黑时，紫色的天上落下无数颗星星。你和家人们一起走进麦田，张开双臂迎接。
text.en:
You never go back to camp. For forty hours they give you clean clothes and call you “family.” You have never felt so safe.
At nightfall countless stars fall from a violet sky. You walk into the wheat with your family and open your arms to welcome them.

text.zh:
你不再等口令。中士在身后喊你，你只听得见鼓声。
多年后，有人在一片无名的战场上见过你：军服早烂成了布条，你还在冲锋，身后的头盔堆成了小山。
血神从不问血是谁的，只要王座下的头骨更高。
text.en:
You stop waiting for orders. The sergeant shouts your number behind you; all you hear is the drum.
Years later someone glimpses you on a nameless battlefield: uniform rotted to rags, still charging, a hill of helmets at your back.
The Blood God never asks whose blood it was. He only wants the skulls piled higher.

text.zh:
你不再怕病，也不再怕死。野战医院的伤员一个个好了，又病了，全都笑眯眯的。
政委来查时，营地已成了一座花园：苍蝇在唱歌，伤口在开花，没人再喊疼。
慈父爱他的每一个孩子，从不让谁孤单。
text.en:
You no longer fear sickness, or death. The field hospital's wounded get better one by one, then sick one by one, all of them smiling.
When the commissar comes to inspect, the camp is a garden: flies singing, wounds in bloom, no one crying out.
Grandfather loves every one of his children, and leaves none of them alone.

text.zh:
勋章、掌声、香膏、更响的赞美诗，你都要，而且要更多。
每一样都比上一样淡。很多年后，人群为你欢呼，喊着你的名字，你什么也感觉不到。
她把你一次次装满，又一次次倒空，直到你只剩下想要。
text.en:
Medals, applause, scented balm, louder hymns: you want them all, and more.
Each tastes fainter than the last. Years later a crowd cheers your name, and you feel nothing.
She fills you and pours you out, again and again, until nothing is left of you but wanting.

text.zh:
你总能先知道命令、战局，和谁会背叛谁。你一步步往上爬。
某天你在作战图上画了一道线，整个团跟着它走进了埋伏。那道线，是镜子里的人替你画的。
你以为自己在下棋，其实你只是一颗棋子。
text.en:
You always know first: the orders, the battle, who will betray whom. Over the years you climb, step by step.
One day you draw a line on the war map, and a whole regiment follows it into an ambush. The one in the mirror drew it for you.
You thought you were playing. You were only a piece.

text.zh:
你没听见第二声枪响。
第二天的阵亡名单上，你的名字后面写着两个字：怯战。
随军牧师念到这里没有停顿，语气仍然是感恩的。
text.en:
You never hear the second shot.
On the next day's casualty list, your name is followed by one word: cowardice.
The regimental priest reads it without pausing. He still sounds grateful.

cause.en: Burned at the gate as heretic

text.zh:
匕首在你手里尖叫，像终于等到了这一刻。
后来，维瑟尔的人只记得那晚城门口烧起了一堆火，颜色很奇怪。
佩尔没有开枪。他闭上了眼睛。
text.en:
The dagger shrieks in your hand, as if it had waited for this moment.
Afterward, the people of Vessel remember only a fire at the gate that night, burning an odd colour.
Pell didn't fire. He closed his eyes.

cause.zh: 腐化败露，被审判庭清除

text.zh:
胜利之后，审判庭开始清查。他们只用一盏灯，照一照你的眼睛。
灯光里，你的影子多了一只手。
他们很有礼貌，甚至给了你一碗热汤。
text.en:
After the victory, the Inquisition begins its audit. They use a single lamp and shine it in your eyes.
In its light, your shadow has an extra hand.
They're very polite. They even bring you a bowl of hot soup.

text.zh:
很多年后，某艘运兵舰的机库里，一个机仆在搬弹药箱。
它一直哼着半句摇篮曲，没人接得上下一句。
偶尔有新兵停下来看它，好像认出了什么。
text.en:
Years later, in a troopship hangar, a servitor hauls ammunition crates.
It hums half a lullaby, over and over. No one can supply the next line.
Now and then a new recruit stops and stares, as if recognising something.

text.zh:
第六工厂陷落了。布琳兑现了承诺：你活着，吃得很饱，胸口多了一只睁开的眼。
后来，你跟着黑色军团去了下一个世界，教他们哪里的门最容易打开。
text.en:
Manufactorum Six falls. Brin keeps her word: you live, you eat well, and an open eye appears upon your chest.
Later you follow the Black Legion to the next world, and teach them which doors open easiest.

text.zh:
那个一直在敲门的声音，终于等到了回答。
你的皮肤在发光，你的影子在说话。政委的子弹来得很快，但还是晚了一步——从你身上爬出来的东西，已经开始笑了。
text.en:
The knocking that never stopped finally gets its answer.
Your skin glows. Your shadow speaks. The commissar's bullet comes fast, but a moment too late. The thing climbing out of you has already begun to laugh.

text.zh:
你倒下的地方没有墓碑，只有一个编号。
多年后，某位执事念到这个编号，语气依旧感恩。
帝国从不缺人。它只缺时间。
text.en:
Where you fall there's no headstone, only a number.
Years later, some deacon reads that number aloud, still sounding grateful.
The Imperium never runs short of people. Only of time.

text.zh:
你开始笑，停不下来。军医给你打了一针，又一针。
后来你被送进一座安静的修道院。那里的人都穿着束缚衣，都在数墙上别人看不见的眼睛。
text.en:
You start laughing and can't stop. A medic gives you a shot, then another.
Later you're sent to a quiet monastery where everyone wears restraints and counts eyes on the walls that no one else can see.

text.zh:
新的探索舰起航了。第一个目的地是G-7，塞瑞丁逃走的方向就在它后面。
星区之外，还有一万座沉睡的墓穴、一万块失落的残片、一万个没人回答的问题。
求知之旅没有终点。这正是你喜欢它的地方。
text.en:
The new explorator ship sets sail. The first mark on its chart is G-7; the way Syrredin fled lies just beyond.
Beyond the sector lie ten thousand sleeping tombs, ten thousand lost fragments, ten thousand unanswered questions.
The Quest has no end. That's what you love about it.

text.zh:
你没有升职，留在第七熔炉当它的看守神甫。
每天早上，你给反应堆念祷文，给传送带上油。
杂役们说，第七熔炉的机魂是全星球脾气最好的。
text.en:
You decline promotion and stay on as keeper of the Seventh Furnace.
Each morning you pray to the reactor and oil the conveyors.
The menials say the Seventh Furnace has the kindest machine spirit on the planet.

cause.en: Became a Magos who kept a heart

text.zh:
三十年后，你成了格拉维克斯的贤者。袍子下的黄铜比同僚少得多，胸口里仍是一颗会疼的心。
你改了转化线的规矩：会数数的、会唱歌的，先送来见你。
你的档案里，名字一栏终于填上了。
text.en:
Thirty years later you are a Magos of Gravex. Far less brass beneath the robe than your peers; in your chest, a heart that still aches.
You change the rules of the conversion line: anyone who can count, or sing, is sent to you first.
In your file, the name field is finally filled in.

cause.en: Survived and went back to work

text.zh:
你没有升职，也没有出发。你回到配额板前，和活下来的杂役一起，把格拉维克斯重新造起来。
你的数字每天都是绿的。
夜里，有人在宿舍里哼一首四个音的歌。你跟着哼。
text.en:
No promotion, no voyage. You go back to the quota board and rebuild Gravex beside the menials who lived.
Your number is green every day.
At night someone in the dormitory hums a four-note song. You hum along.

text.zh:
你先是把工具焊在了手上，后来把整条胳膊换成了链锯。
格拉维克斯造的每一门炮你都想亲手试射，靶子从铁板变成了人。
血神不在乎你的植入体是什么型号，只在乎它们还在开火。
text.en:
First you weld your tools to your hand; later you swap the whole arm for a chainblade.
You want to test-fire every gun Gravex makes; the targets change from steel plates to people.
The Blood God doesn't care what model your implants are. Only that they keep firing.

cause.en: Taken by Nurgle with the rust

text.zh:
你不再给机器上油。锈是温柔的，它让一切慢下来，却从不让它们停下。
第七熔炉开满了橙色的锈花，机仆们在花丛里哼歌，永远不会坏，也永远不会好。
慈父说，这才是不朽。
text.en:
You stop oiling the machines. Rust is gentle: it slows everything and never lets it stop.
The Seventh Furnace blooms with orange rust; servitors hum among the flowers, never breaking, never mending.
Grandfather says this is the true immortality.

text.zh:
每一个植入体都很完美，直到你看见下一个型号。
你换了眼睛、手、心、声音，直到镜子里再没有一块原装零件。
你仍不满意。色孽最爱的，正是这种永远差一点的完美。
text.en:
Every implant is perfect, until you see the next model.
You replace eyes, hands, heart, voice, until the mirror holds not one original part.
Still you're not satisfied. Slaanesh loves exactly this: perfection forever one step away.

text.zh:
你终于补全了一块STC残片。缺的那部分，是奸奇亲手填上的。
设计完美，能造出任何东西，可每造一件，图纸就改变一处。
你造了一辈子，从没造出过同一样东西。这正是他的计划。
text.en:
At last you complete an STC fragment. The missing part was filled in by Tzeentch's own hand.
The design is perfect and can build anything, but each time it builds, the blueprint changes.
You build all your life and never make the same thing twice. Which was his plan.

text.zh:
塞瑞丁兑现了承诺：你问什么，他答什么。
你学会了把恶魔写进机器，把机器写进血肉。格拉维克斯在身后燃烧，你忙着记笔记。
很多年后，你给自己换了一只手，关节多一个。
text.en:
Syrredin keeps his promise: whatever you ask, he answers.
You learn to write daemons into machines and machines into flesh. Gravex burns behind you; you're busy taking notes.
Years later you give yourself a new hand, with one joint too many.

cause.en: Kept by orks to fix their guns

text.zh:
机械佬给你起了个名字：“小扳手”。你每天给兽人修枪，修得越好，它们越开心。
后来你发现，枪修不修都能打响，只要它们相信。
你开始怀疑学过的一切，也开始相信：红的跑得快。
text.en:
The Mek names you “Lil' Spanner”. Every day you fix ork guns; the better you fix them, the happier they are.
Later you notice the guns fire whether fixed or not, as long as the orks believe.
You begin to doubt everything you learned. And to believe red ones go faster.

text.zh:
仪式很成功。你看清了一切：格拉维克斯的产能、黑暗马戈斯的弱点、自己剩余的寿命。
你不害怕，不后悔，也不再记得那首歌。
瓦伦贤者说你是他最好的作品。你同意。这是一个正确的数据。
text.en:
The Rite succeeds. You see everything clearly: Gravex's output, the Dark Magos's weaknesses, your own remaining lifespan.
You feel no fear, no regret, and no longer remember the song.
Magos Vallen calls you his finest work. You agree. It is a correct datum.

text.zh:
你把恶魔引擎的核心带回圣库，只想看看它是怎么运转的。
法庭的判决只有一个二进制词：异端。
他们没有把你改成机仆。他们怕那颗核心已经教会了你的大脑什么。
text.en:
You bring the engine's core back to the Vault. You only want to see how it works.
The tribunal's verdict is one binary word: heresy.
They don't make you a servitor. They fear what the core has already taught your brain.

text.zh:
你醒来时，已经不再需要醒来。
你的编号牌上有一串数字。你推着矿车，步伐整齐。
隔壁的机仆在哼一首四个音的歌。你不知道为什么，也跟着哼了起来。
text.en:
You wake no longer needing to wake.
Your plate bears a string of digits. You push an ore cart, perfectly in step.
The servitor beside you hums a four-note song. Without knowing why, you hum along.

text.zh:
你身体里的机器开始说另一种语言。它们不再听你的，也不再听万机之神的。
你的植入体长出了牙齿，血变成了黄铜色。
会有人把你造成一台很好的引擎。
text.en:
The machines inside you start speaking another language. They no longer obey you, nor the Omnissiah.
Your implants grow teeth; your blood turns the colour of brass.
Someone will make you into a very fine engine.

text.zh:
你倒下了。后来来收尸的是两个机仆，它们只评估你身上还有多少可回收零件。
不多。植入体被拆下来，整整齐齐码进回收箱。
剩下的部分，被归档为“耗材”。
text.en:
You fall. The ones who come for the body are two servitors; they only assess how many recoverable parts you hold.
Not many. Your implants are removed and stacked neatly in the salvage bin.
The rest is filed as ‘consumables’.

text.zh:
你开始只用二进制说话，后来只用二进制思考，最后只剩一串重复的数字。
神甫们检查了你，宣布你的心智“已格式化”。
转化线很欢迎你。这一次，你不用排队。
text.en:
You begin speaking only in binary, then thinking only in binary, until nothing is left but a repeating string of digits.
The priests examine you and declare your mind ‘formatted’.
The conversion line welcomes you. This time, no queue.

cause.zh: 在生者与死者之间传话
cause.en: Go-between for the living and the dead

text.zh:
没有条约，只有一条线：沙丘这边归活人，金字塔那边归死人。莫丹收了枪，塞赫拉特收了军团。
你在线上搭了个帐篷，替两边传话。审判庭的档案里，你的名字后面写着：“暂缓处理”。
text.en:
No treaty, only a line: this side of the dunes for the living, the pyramid's side for the dead. Mordane holsters her pistol; Sekhrat recalls his legions.
You pitch a tent on the line and carry words between them. In the Inquisition's files, your name is marked: “Deferred.”

text.zh:
净化之火烧掉了大教堂和营地；金字塔早已沉回沙下。
地底深处，一个人类坐在冰冷的大厅里，借着绿光写一部历史，写给六千万年后醒来的人。
霸主偶尔来检查发音。
text.en:
The purging fire takes the cathedral and the camp; the pyramid has long since sunk beneath the sand.
Far below, a human sits in a cold hall writing a history by green light, for whoever wakes in sixty million years.
The overlord drops by now and then to check the pronunciation.

text.zh:
画廊多了一位会说话的讲解员。
你给每件藏品重写说明，替凝固的人记住名字。卡尔中士的铭牌改成了：“祈祷中。附注：有人听见了。”
收藏家说，这是他见过最好的修改。
text.en:
The gallery gains a talking docent.
You rewrite every plaque, remembering names for the frozen. Sergeant Kaal's now reads: “Praying. Note: someone heard.”
The Collector calls it the finest edit he has ever seen.

text.zh:
穿梭机冲出大气层时，下面的沙漠亮起了净化之火。轨道上，一艘自由贸易商的船收了你。
你抱着那份报告，一页没少。帝国不会出版它，审判庭会追捕它。
但真相现在有了一个活着的抄本：你。
text.en:
As the shuttle breaks atmosphere, purging fire blooms over the desert below. In orbit a Free Trader takes you aboard.
You clutch the report, not one page lost. The Imperium will never publish it; the Inquisition will hunt it.
But the truth now has a living copy: you.

text.zh:
游侠把你带进沙丘背后那道光缝。身后，忒萨零号的天空亮起了净化之火。
网道把你放在一颗没有名字的星球上，离帝国很远，离死人更远。
先知说，这是她欠你的。灵族记账，比死灵还久。
text.en:
The rangers lead you into the seam behind the dune. Behind you, purging fire lights Thessa Null's sky.
The webway sets you down on a nameless world, far from the Imperium, farther from the dead.
The seer says it is a debt repaid. Aeldari keep accounts even longer than necrons.

cause.en: Taken by Khorne outside the tomb

text.zh:
你的怒气无处可去。死灵没有灵魂，不值得杀，它只在你胸口打转。
直到你离开零场的那一刻，鼓声一下子涌了进来。
你扑向第一个活人时，血神接住了你，像接住一把等了很久的刀。
text.en:
Your rage has nowhere to go. The necrons have no souls, not worth killing, so it burns in circles in your chest.
The moment you leave the null field, the drumming floods in.
As you lunge at the first living person, the Blood God catches you, like a blade he has waited a long time for.

cause.en: Taken by Nurgle outside the tomb

text.zh:
零场像一层冰，压住了你身上那点温吞吞的东西。它不急，它在等。
后来你离开了死人的地方。第一步踩下去，所有的病一起醒了，暖得像回家。
慈父很有耐心。一座六千万年的墓，也关不住他的孩子。
text.en:
The necrons' null field lies on you like ice, pressing down the lukewarm thing inside you. It's in no hurry. It waits.
Later you leave the place of the dead. At your first step, every sickness wakes at once, warm as coming home.
Grandfather is patient. Not even a sixty-million-year tomb can keep his children from him.

text.zh:
你总想让那一刻再完美一点：姿势，表情，光线。
零场挡住了她，挡不住你自己的渴望。技师把你冻进停滞场时，你还在调整姿势。
铭牌上写着：“人类，渴望中。”你会这样想要下去，直到群星熄灭。
text.en:
You always want that moment a little more perfect: the pose, the expression, the light.
The null field keeps Her hand away, but not your own wanting. When a cryptek freezes you in stasis, you are still adjusting your pose.
The plaque reads: “Human, wanting.” You will go on wanting until the stars go out.

cause.en: Taken by Tzeentch outside the tomb

text.zh:
会变的字越来越多。在零场里，它们只能沉默。
你离开零场、看见星空的那一刻，它们一齐开口：“你终于出来了。答案都备好了。”
你想知道的，从此都知道了。只是每个答案都通向下一个计划。
text.en:
The shifting lines multiply. Inside the null field they can only keep silent.
The moment you leave it and see the stars, they all speak at once: “At last. We've prepared every answer for you.”
Everything you ever wanted to know, you now know. Only every answer leads to another plan.

text.zh:
碎片没有吃你的身体。它吃掉了你对死亡的恐惧，然后是恐惧底下的一切。
几天后，技师们在笼子旁找到一具完好的人类躯壳，还在微笑。
星神很满意。它很久没吃这么饱了。
text.en:
The shard doesn't eat your body. It eats your fear of death, then everything beneath the fear.
Days later the crypteks find an intact human shell beside the cage, still smiling.
The star god is satisfied. It hasn't eaten this well in ages.

text.zh:
第七十七号藏品：原始学者，发现中。
几千年来，参观者都会在这个展位前停下。他们说那个人类的表情很生动，好像随时会眨眼。
你一次都没有眨过。
text.en:
Item 77: Primitive Scholar, Mid-Discovery.
For thousands of years visitors pause at this display. They say the human's expression is so vivid, as if about to blink.
You never blink once.

text.zh:
梅鲁克勋爵牵起你的手，带你走进一个没有光的地方。那里很冷，挤满了想要变暖的东西。
你开始理解他们。你开始觉得冷。
你开始看别人的皮肤，觉得那看起来很暖和。
text.en:
Lord Meruk takes your hand and leads you somewhere without light. It is cold there, crowded with things that want to be warm.
You begin to understand them. You begin to feel cold.
You start looking at other people's skin. It looks so warm.

cause.zh: 因所知过多被审判庭处决

text.zh:
审判庭的记录很简短：证人一名，所知过多，已处理。
他们在你的档案上盖了红章，和第一支勘测队的放在一起。
后来有人说，沙丘上那排靴子又多了一双，鞋尖朝外。
text.en:
The Inquisition's record is brief: one witness, knew too much, processed.
They stamp your file red and shelve it beside the first survey team's.
Later someone says the row of boots on the dune has grown by one pair, toes pointing out.

text.zh:
技师们想知道：没有星神，这件事还做不做得成。他们很仔细，几乎是温柔的。疼只疼了一会儿，然后什么都没有了。
你站在朝臣的队列里，眼睛亮着。霸主问你问题时，你只记得回答“是”。
text.en:
The crypteks want to know whether it can still be done without a star god. They are careful, almost tender. The pain lasts a moment; then nothing.
You stand among the courtiers, eyes glowing. When the overlord asks you something, you only remember how to say yes.

text.zh:
有什么古老的东西一直在小口啜饮你。今天，它喝到了杯底。
你身上属于“人”的部分，一点不剩。
剩下的那具身体还在走，还在笑，替某颗饥饿的星星打量着别的活物。
text.en:
Something ancient has been sipping at you. Today it reaches the bottom of the cup.
Nothing human is left in you.
The body that remains still walks and smiles, sizing up other living things for some hungry star.

text.zh:
你倒下了。几只金属甲虫不知从哪儿赶来，绕你转了一圈，判定你已经没有用了。
它们收走你的灯、你的笔，码得整整齐齐。
你成了又一座整齐的沙丘。
text.en:
You fall. A few metal scarabs arrive from nowhere, circle you once, and decide you're no longer useful.
They collect your lamp and your pen and stack them neatly.
You become one more tidy dune.

text.zh:
你开始用死灵的方式说话：没有起伏，没有停顿。然后你开始用他们的方式沉默。
你站定了，一动不动，眼睛睁着，等一道永远不会下达的命令。
text.en:
You start speaking the necron way: no rise, no pause. Then you start keeping silent their way.
You stand perfectly still, eyes open, awaiting an order that will never come.

text.zh:
两年后，大Waaagh!里流传着一个传说：人仔机械佬，认得人仔的字，修得好人仔的船。
兽人叫你“牙人仔”。你有一罐牙，一副护目镜，和一个没人敢动的位置。
有时你想起自己曾是人。偶尔。
text.en:
Two years on, da Prophet's Great Waaagh! tells a legend: an 'umie Mek who reads 'umie writing and fixes 'umie ships.
The orks call you Toof 'Umie. You have a jar of teef, a pair of goggles, and a place nobody dares touch.
Sometimes you remember you were human. Sometimes.

text.zh:
炮艇载着你穿过雷暴。你把看到的一切告诉星际战士：机械佬、怪小子、先知的舰队。
情报被发往奥雷克斯二号，大Waaagh!的下一站。
那边的人能比伊斯卡隆多准备几天。也许就够了。
text.en:
The gunship carries you through the storm. You tell the Marines everything: the Mek, the Weirdboy, da Prophet's fleet.
The report goes to Aurex Secundus, the Great Waaagh!'s next stop.
They'll have a few more days to prepare than Iskaron did. Maybe that's enough.

text.zh:
海盗船冲出伊斯卡隆的绿天时，你回头看了一眼。整颗星球在燃烧，在吼叫。
红戈布扔给你一顶插羽毛的帽子。“自由海盗，”他说，“没有老大，只有牙。”
你把帽子戴上了。有点大，不过你会长的。
text.en:
As the pirate ship tears out of Iskaron's green sky, you look back once. The whole planet is burning and roaring.
Redgob tosses you a feathered hat. “Freebooterz,” he says. “No boss. Just teef.”
You put it on. It's a bit big. You'll grow into it.

cause.en: Taken by Khorne in the endless war

text.zh:
伊斯卡隆的仗没完没了：兽人打，人类打，天上掉下来的也打。你打得越来越好，越来越停不下来。
有一天你发现，你已经不在乎打的是谁了。
血神很满意。这颗星球永远不缺头骨，现在也不缺你。
text.en:
Iskaron's war never ends: orks fight, humans fight, whatever falls from the sky fights. You get better at it, and less able to stop.
One day you realise you no longer care who you're fighting.
The Blood God is pleased. This world never lacks skulls, and now it doesn't lack you.

cause.en: Taken by Nurgle in the spore-beds

text.zh:
你在堡垒边上的蘑菇地里躺下歇一会儿。孢子很暖，泥土很软。
醒来时，你身上也长出了小小的蘑菇，带着一股甜腻的、放久了的味道。
兽人以为你是一种新的史奎格。慈父知道你是谁的孩子。
text.en:
You lie down in the mushroom beds by the fort for a rest. The spores are warm; the soil is soft.
When you wake, little mushrooms grow on you too, with a sweet, stale smell.
The orks think you're a new kind of squig. Grandfather knows whose child you are.

text.zh:
你开始擦亮一切：枪、牙、护目镜、自己的脸。
兽人里最爱臭美的“亮仔”都夸你擦得好。可再亮也不够亮。
你擦了很多年，直到镜子里的自己完美得不像人。她喜欢完美。
text.en:
You start polishing everything: guns, teef, goggles, your own face.
Even the vainest Flash Gitz praise your shine. But it's never shiny enough.
You polish for years, until the face in the mirror is too perfect to be human. She loves perfect.

text.zh:
你开始觉得自己弄懂了兽人的科技：信念让机器转动。
可你想得太深，想到了更深处那个也靠信念活着的东西。它说：你相信的，我都能让它成真。
你造的第一台机器完美无缺。它会变。它一直在变。
text.en:
You start to think you understand ork tech: belief turns the gears.
But you think too deep, down to something else that lives on belief. It says: whatever you believe, I can make real.
The first machine you build is flawless. It changes. It never stops changing.

cause.en: Shot by a commissar as a collaborator

text.zh:
军事法庭只开了四分钟。罪名：通敌。证据：你还活着。
黑尔政委亲自执行。枪声被兽人的吼声盖住了，没人听见。
档案上写着：伊斯卡隆，平民一名，已处理。
text.en:
The court-martial takes four minutes. Charge: collaboration. Evidence: you're alive.
Commissar Hale carries out the sentence himself. The orks' roaring drowns the shot; nobody hears.
The file reads: Iskaron, one civilian, processed.

cause.en: Rebuilt by the Dok, mostly ork

text.zh:
锯牙医生佬把你当成了毕生杰作。一条绿胳膊，两条绿腿，一颗不知道是谁的心。
你比任何人类都强壮，打架时会忍不住吼。
只是有时候，你想不起自己吼的是哪种语言。
text.en:
Dok Sawtoof makes you his life's masterpiece. One green arm, two green legs, a heart from who knows whom.
You're stronger than any human, and you can't help roaring when you fight.
Sometimes you can't remember which language you're roaring in.

cause.en: A lifetime slaving for the Waaagh!

text.zh:
你跟着大Waaagh!走了十年，从一颗星球到另一颗。
你给机械佬递扳手，给地精分口粮，给史奎格喂剩饭。没人记得你的名字，地精们管你叫“大地精”。
你不再数日子了。兽人不数，你也不数。
text.en:
You follow the Great Waaagh! for ten years, world to world.
You hand Meks their spanners, share rations with grots, feed scraps to squigs. Nobody remembers your name; the grots call you Big Grot.
You stop counting days. Orks don't. Neither do you.

text.zh:
你身上的记号越来越多，越来越烫。
某天早上，你的身体终于撑不住了，变成一团不停冒出新嘴巴的东西。
兽人们兴奋地围过来：“好怪的家伙！揍它！”这是它们能给的最高赞美。
text.en:
The marks on you multiply and burn hotter.
One morning your body gives way and becomes a heap that keeps sprouting new mouths.
The orks crowd round, thrilled. “WEIRD 'UN! KRUMP IT!” It's the highest praise they have.

text.zh:
你倒下了。兽人把你和一千件别的废品一起扔上了废铁堆。
地精仔来了，拿走你的靴子、你的扳手，连兜里那颗牙也没放过。
明年这里会长出蘑菇，蘑菇底下会长出兽人。兽人不会知道你是谁。
text.en:
You fall. The orks toss you onto the scrap heap with a thousand other pieces of junk.
Grots come and take your boots, your spanner, even the toof in your pocket.
Next year mushrooms will grow here, and under them, orks. The orks won't know who you were.

cause.en: Went mad believing you're an ork

text.zh:
你开始在梦里吼“Waaagh！”，后来醒着也吼。
你把自己刷成绿色，相信自己会变大、变强、变快。兽人们看着你，没笑，有点感动。
你信得很用力。可惜，信念只对兽人管用。
text.en:
You start roaring “WAAAGH!” in your sleep, then awake.
You paint yourself green and believe you'll grow bigger, stronger, faster. The orks watch, not laughing. A little moved.
You believe so hard. Pity belief only works for orks.

cause.en: Honoured citizen of the Greater Good

text.zh:
一年后，在新的殖民地，瓦尚亲手把勋章别在你胸前。你是第一个获此荣誉的古维萨。
街区的孩子会在钛人的学校长大，学会说钛语，学会完美的微笑。
你常常想，这是好事。你几乎每次都这么想。
text.en:
A year later, on a new colony, Vash'aun pins the medal on your chest himself. You're the first gue'vesa so honoured.
The quarter's children will grow up in T'au schools, speak T'au, and learn the perfect smile.
You often think this is a good thing. Almost every time.

text.zh:
红色的战斗服在海湾边等着。凯尔拉回头看了一眼达尔诺尔，没有说再见。
远见的飞地里，钛人、人类和克鲁特会为了一个决定吵上整整一夜。
没人叫这“暂时的误会”。他们叫它“开会”。
text.en:
The crimson battlesuit waits at the edge of the Gulf. Kel'ra looks back at Dal'nor once and doesn't say goodbye.
In Farsight's Enclaves, T'au, humans and Kroot argue all night over a single decision.
Nobody calls it a temporary misunderstanding. They call it a meeting.

text.zh:
你留了下来，和几个不肯走的人一起重建达尔诺尔。
旧教堂的空讲台上，挂着一枚双头鹰，旁边是钛人的圆环。
两年了，没人把哪一个摘下来。
text.en:
You stay to rebuild Dal'nor with the few who wouldn't leave.
On the old chapel's empty pulpit hangs an eagle, and beside it, a T'au ring.
Two years on, nobody has taken either one down.

text.zh:
钛人没见过这种病：一个古维萨，越打越不疼，越打越停不下。
无人机把你记作“效率异常”，火族不再和你一起出击。某天你独自走进丛林，去找下一场仗。
大义需要理由，血神不需要。他只要头骨。
text.en:
The T'au have never seen this sickness: a gue'vesa who feels less pain with every fight, and cannot stop.
Drones log you as an efficiency anomaly; the fire caste stop deploying with you. One day you walk into the jungle alone, looking for the next fight.
The Greater Good needs reasons. The Blood God needs only skulls.

text.zh:
人类街区闹起了咳嗽病，从你开始。你一点也不难受，挨家挨户给邻居送汤。
医疗无人机封了整条街。钛人隔着能量屏，困惑地看着一群笑眯眯的病人。
慈父不懂大义，他只知道每个孩子都该有个家。
text.en:
A coughing sickness breaks out in the human quarter, and it starts with you. You feel fine, and go door to door bringing your neighbours soup.
Medical drones seal the whole street. Behind the energy screen, the T'au stare in confusion at a crowd of smiling sick people.
Grandfather knows nothing of the Greater Good. Only that every child deserves a home.

text.zh:
钛人的世界太节制了：定量的口粮，定量的称赞。你要的不止这些。
你在人类街区办了一场不散的聚会：更甜的糖，更响的音乐，更多掌声。
客人们都很满足，第二天又来。最后被掏空的，是你自己。
text.en:
The T'au world is too measured: rationed food, rationed praise. You want more than that.
In the human quarter you throw a party that never ends: sweeter sugar, louder music, more applause.
Everyone leaves satisfied, and comes back the next day. The last one hollowed out is you.

text.zh:
你在梦里看见钛人的作战计划，比以太族看得还远。
你把它们一页页写下来，卖给水族，卖给海湾那边的人，也卖给帝国。每一方都以为你是自己人。
直到三方同时发现了。那一天，也写在计划里。
text.en:
In dreams you see the T'au battle plans, further ahead than any Ethereal can.
You write them down page by page and sell them: to the water caste, to people across the Gulf, to the Imperium. Each side thinks you're theirs.
Until all three find out at once. That day was in the plan too.

text.zh:
政委耐心地听完了你的话，点点头，像是在认可一份报告。
然后他宣读了判决。很短。
第二天，帝国广播多了一条：“新卡尔德，清除叛徒两名。”雷娜姨的吊坠被收走了，说圣物不宜流落。
text.en:
The commissar hears you out patiently, nodding as if approving a report.
Then he reads the sentence. It's short.
Next day the Imperial broadcast adds a line: “New Calder: two traitors removed.” Rena's pendant is confiscated. Holy relics, they say, mustn't go astray.

text.zh:
口袋里，92号的碎片忽然亮了，哔了两声。你转身走回孢子雾里，去找它想让你找的东西。
雾里有东西在动。成千上万。
克鲁特吃东西是为了记住。虫子吃东西是为了忘掉。这一次，什么也不会被记住。
text.en:
In your pocket, Drone 92's fragment suddenly lights up and beeps twice. You turn back into the spore fog to find whatever it wants you to find.
Something moves in the fog. Thousands of somethings.
Kroot eat to remember. Bugs eat to forget. This time, nothing will be remembered.

text.zh:
凯尔拉闭上了眼睛，然后扣下了扳机。
报告上写着：“安全事件，已处理。”
一周后，第三批撤离如期“暂时推迟”。再也没有恢复。
text.en:
Kel'ra closes her eyes. Then she pulls the trigger.
The report reads: “Security incident. Resolved.”
A week later the third wave remains “temporarily postponed.” It is never resumed.

text.zh:
对话进行了很久。两年。
你出来时晒不到太阳，脸色白了些，说话慢了些，见人就笑，笑得完美得像量过尺寸。
码头上的老工友在街上认不出你。你也不太记得他们了。这是一个暂时的误会。
text.en:
The dialogue goes on a long time. Two years.
You come out pale from no sun, slower of speech. You smile at everyone, a smile so perfect it looks measured.
Your old workmates from the docks pass you in the street without recognising you. You don't quite remember them either. A temporary misunderstanding.

cause.zh: 沦为排在第三批的难民
cause.en: A refugee in the third wave

text.zh:
你挤在最后一艘船的货舱里，和人类、克鲁特、几箱土族设备一起。
二十天后，钛族边境的难民站给每个人发了一张淡蓝色的卡片，写着新的安置批次：第三批。
你等着。大家都在等。
text.en:
You're crammed into the last ship's hold with humans, Kroot and crates of earth-caste equipment.
Twenty days later a T'au border refugee station hands everyone a pale blue card with a new resettlement wave: third.
You wait. Everyone waits.

text.zh:
西拉斯没有说谎：那个神真的会听人类说话。
它听得太仔细了，仔细到搬了进来。
钛人的传感器把你登记为“未知生物信号”。他们说，从没见过这种东西。
text.en:
Silas didn't lie: that god really does listen to humans.
It listened so closely that it moved in.
T'au sensors log you as “unknown biological signal.” They say they've never seen anything like it.

text.zh:
瓦尚在报告上签了字。你的名字被归入一栏：“可接受的损失（人类）”。
他的笑容一如既往。
后来，有个克鲁特说他记得你。没人知道他是怎么记住的。
text.en:
Vash'aun signs the report. Your name goes into a column: “Acceptable losses (human).”
His smile is the same as ever.
Later, a Kroot says he remembers you. No one asks how.

text.zh:
你一直在做的那个梦，终于醒不过来了。
门、眼睛、走调的歌，全都挤进你的脑子里，没有一样是你自己的。
你不再害怕了。你什么都不再是了。
text.en:
The dream you kept having finally won't let you wake.
The door, the eye, the out-of-tune song all crowd into your head, and none of it is yours.
You are no longer afraid. You are no longer anything.
